description:
Pre-close gate for bl-7c23. After final phase merges, audit implementation against:
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1-§2.10 (terms, layout, branches, dispatch, merges, compaction, goals, stops, retries).
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3.1, §3.3, §3.5 (disk-as-bus, tools-and-skills, UI contract).
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4.1-§4.3, §5.1-§5.4 (providers split, context assembly, worktree invariant).
- docs/PRINCIPLES.md (single source of truth, control vs data plane, frozen-copy bootstrap, file path as hint).
- docs/TAXONOMY.md (banned-usage rule — no 'invocation' as a structural term in code or comments).

For each ARCH section above, sample two implementation points and confirm they match the spec. Flag any drift as a follow-up ball under this epic; do not silently close over divergence.
Close when audit notes posted and any drift balls filed.
title: Gate: alignment (v0.3 layout migration)
